package example.bankwealth.v2.domain.entities.behaviors

import example.bankwealth.v2.domain.entities.FundOrderEntity._

object FundOrderEventHandler extends EventHandler {
  override def apply(state: State, input: Event): State = input match {
    case event: CashRequestSourceRecorded =>
      state
    case event: FundPurchaseSettlementRequested =>
      state
    case event: FundTASharesConfirmed =>
      state.copy(taStatus = "confirmed")
    case event: IndependentRefundRequested =>
      state
  }
}
